name: Advertised Lotteries on Housing Connect by Lottery
description:
This dataset lists affordable housing lotteries advertised through New York City's Housing Connect system, with one row per lottery. Each record includes the lottery's name and status, development type, start and end dates, and the number of buildings and units involved. Unit counts are broken out by bedroom size (studio through 4-bedroom), and the share of units set aside for different income bands is given as applied AMI (Area Median Income) percentages ranging from extremely low to above-middle income. The data also records the percentage of units reserved for specific preference groups, such as people with mobility, vision, or hearing needs, community board residents, municipal employees, NYCHA residents, and applicants aged 62 and over. Location details include borough, postcode, community board, and latitude/longitude coordinates.

The dataset could be used to analyze the supply and geographic distribution of affordable housing lotteries across the city, compare unit sizes and income targeting across developments, track how lottery activity changes over time
